risk_codes.abandonment: Project is at elevated chance of leaving the queue in ~12 months.
risk_codes.system_congestion: The planned delayed-MW pile is large versus history (system crowding).
risk_codes.gia_execution: Project is in GIA / IA — execution and offtake risk, not just study-queue risk.
risk_codes.cod_already_slipped: Planned service date is already at or before the as-of date.
risk_codes.developer_serial_quit: This sponsor’s prior projects withdrew at a high rate.
risk_codes.restudy_friction: Study restudies are already on the record.
risk_codes.hazard_exposure: County FEMA risk is high versus the training distribution.
risk_codes.cost_pressure: Network upgrade cost or cost-per-MW is elevated.
risk_codes.policy_incentive: Energy-community / IRA bonus-credit flag is on (financing context, not a delay model).

do_not_claim: do not quote months of future COD slip as a model output
do not claim a MISO Step-Up / Firm Service failure record
do not treat EIA delayed MW as a complete GIA list (overlay is thin)
do not treat scenario deltas as causal effects
do not use FERC-730 as a clean delay source
do not unseal 2024 test labels or tune on test/score

abandonment.title: Elevated withdrawal risk
actions: Treat P(quit) as a ranking input, not a guaranteed outcome.
Check milestone security, offtake, and financing against the 12-month window.
If the sponsor is serial-high, require extra diligence before restudy spend.

system_congestion.title: System delayed-MW crowding
actions: Use the pile as regime context (everyone late), not this plant’s COD.
Stress study / construction calendars against a larger delayed stock 3 and 12 months out.
Do not convert pile RMSE into a project-level month slip.

gia_execution.title: GIA / IA execution
actions: Switch the playbook from queue-entry screening to GIA milestone tracking.
Confirm offtake, site control, and construction start vs the current ISD.

cod_already_slipped.title: Service date already passed
actions: The date has already moved (fact). Do not ask the model for additional months of slip.
Re-baseline offtake and interconnection milestones against the last known ISD.

developer_serial_quit.title: Sponsor withdrawal history
actions: Weight sponsor track record in credit / collateral discussions.
Compare this project’s P(quit) to the sponsor’s prior withdrawal rate; do not double-count blindly.

restudy_friction.title: Restudy already on the record
actions: Flag restudy cost and delay as already-realized process risk.
Scenario overlay `restudy` shows how P(quit) moves if another restudy is recorded — sensitivity, not physics.

hazard_exposure.title: Local FEMA hazard
actions: Bring county hazard into siting / insurance review; it is context, not a COD model.

cost_pressure.title: Upgrade / network cost pressure
actions: Review assigned network upgrade cost vs MW before committing to the next study cycle.

policy_incentive.title: Energy-community / IRA context
actions: IRA bonus-credit eligibility is a financing overlay. Replace this stub with the company policy PDF.

enter_gia.name: enter_gia
enter_gia.note: If study_phase were IA Executed (GIA/IA). Sensitivity, not a causal GIA effect.

already_past_cod.name: already_past_cod
already_past_cod.note: If the planned service date were already 12+ months past as-of. Fact overlay, not Platinum 1 months.

restudy.name: restudy
restudy.note: If one additional restudy were on the record.

rate_shock.name: rate_shock
rate_shock.note: If observation interest rate were +2 points vs the row.

serial_developer.name: serial_developer
serial_developer.note: If sponsor prior withdrawal rate were at least 75%.

high_system_delay.name: high_system_delay
high_system_delay.note: Pile crowding forced high. Electrum X unchanged; P(quit) delta is 0 unless you retrain with pile features.

calibration_note: Electrum CatBoost joblib (trial-149 recipe). Freeze catboost_tuned is not on disk (gitignored). Do not apply freeze Platt to this score distribution.
